node.statement: Complementary projections. In the exact finite-dimensional C*-algebra B=B_U direct-sum B_V, let Pi_U=(I_{B_U},0) and Pi_V=(0,I_{B_V}); these are complementary source projections, their diagonal corners are B_U,B_V, and their off-diagonal corners are zero. In the target, linearity of Co^A_{P_R}, the identity P_R=P_U+P_V, and the compressed-unit conclusion of lem-compcb-corner-algebra give P_U^R+P_V^R=Co^A_{P_R}(P_U+P_V)=Co^A_{P_R}(P_R)=I_{A_R}. Thus quantitative target complementarity holds with error zero, while node 1.3 gives that both targets are C_nest*t-projections; both requirements are bounded by rho=C_cross*t.
